Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You speak, and strange replies arrive clear: a growl full of hunger, a ghost's broken warning, the polished words of a distant court. You give them all a place in the conversation.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self and creatures within 6 squares who hear the conversation.
Limits
Lead one such conversation at a time.
Type
Magic / Utility

For the scene while you lead the conversation, participants understand the deliberate spoken messages and calls exchanged in it, according to each creature's own capacity for understanding.

Name one agreement you seek. You and willing allies participating in the conversation gain 2 Boons to Guile, Knowledge or Reason rolls made to negotiate that agreement.
